text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Onto the final stretch! Among this star-studded lineup,
who will break away... !?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhh~!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle! It's Hishi Miracle!
She pulls off another miracle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*...
*wheeze*... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay...... Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...*cough*, *hack*, *blegh*!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So thoroughly exhausted that even a victory roar is beyond reach.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “—A true miracle. In a Takarazuka Kinen featuring the strongest lineup in history, Hishi Miracle has seized a glorious victory!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Even Symboli Kris S is left stunned!
Conquering the Spring Tenno Sho,
and now a glorious victory in the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: She is not just a long-distance stayer. Could she perhaps be the strongest currently active... !?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The loaded special is the best!!
Thanks for the feast!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And to everyone who placed their big dreams
on me, congratulations~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh...!?
She really won...!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, yeahhh!
I... I always believed in you--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fans saw their own reflections in that figure.
Through Hishi Miracle's victory—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The entire racecourse was enveloped in a warm hope:
the belief that 'anyone is allowed to dream.'

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. Kris S,
you got completely played.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Living up to the dreams placed upon us, huh?
Now that's quite romantic.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: But—that is still all it is.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
The Mission I want to accomplish—is nowhere in sight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... even to herself.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ha, what a stick in the mud. Well, we'll find out in time.
Just what kind of treasure they're after.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the night following
a victory that will go down in history—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
umm~ can I talk to you for a second...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I expected nothing but smiles... but
her expression was surprisingly serious.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I just realized something.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I realized that up until now, it was my Trainer who was making those tough resolves for me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to live up to that,
so I was able to run today without any hesitation."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I could live up to it a bit, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I could ever
become like you,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To push forward with the resolve of losing everything,
or being resented by others... that's just too much...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that airy side of me
will never completely go away. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still, from here on out—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to become someone who can shoulder the burden together with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I have at least steeled my resolve for that.
So please...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
From here on... will you watch?
My full power.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This is me giving everything I've got,
fully prepared to the very limit.
choice_data_list: Yeah... I want you to show me.
Yeah... I want you to show me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finally, Hishi Miracle smiled.
In this Takarazuka Kinen,
she seemed to have shaken off whatever was holding her back.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "So, Trainer, about the next race!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking another middle-distance GⅠ would be good.
Even though I managed to win this time...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I can't run as consistently as Kris S-chan just yet, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of the first medium-distance GⅠ of the fall,
there's the 2000m 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)', but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait up. Trainer-san, together.
Let's say it together.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: You just said we'd shoulder it together, didn't you? That's why!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, they decided to say it in unison.
That's right, the next race is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ready, and!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, this kinda thing is really nice~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let you carry it alone anymore. From here on,
lean on my shoulders with everything you've got."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having resolved herself, the reborn Hishi Miracle
headed for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
bursting with motivation.
